title: Indomie Mi Goreng BBQ Chicken Flavour Instant Noodles 5x80g $3.55 (S&S) + Delivery ($0 with Prime/ $59 Spend) @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: Indomie Mi Goreng BBQ Chicken Flavour Instant Noodles 5x80g $3.55 (S&S) + Delivery ($0 with Prime/ $59 Spend) @ Amazon AU

[IlIlIl IlI llIIIl] Satay mi goreng and the chicken one is available as a two for $7 deal. Stacks with S&S so became $6.21 delivered
[Palindrome777] Go to OPs deal. There is a 'save more' box under the item to buy two for 7. You can add the satay flavour from there
[wink] where can i buy the XL mi goreng or is it discontinued
[RTX9090Ti] better to eat 2 packs of these to make up for the XL.
[AustriaBargain] two packs is too much for one meal. Don't have to eat it all I suppose.
[donman92] Don't forget some uberone Coles deals for 40% off indomie products (possibly targeted)
[Taro Milk Tea] Not a bargain, many local groceries sell this 40c per piece.
[Skinnerr] Lots of those are grey imports from (?) or close to/out of date.
[Taro Milk Tea] Most of them are not the export quality, which tastes way much better.
[Vladdo] Loads of local groceries sell these but don't nearly have as much flavours in the packet which makes them not worth eating.
[safrane] First time I found out about the difference, now I have to taste test it.
[Taro Milk Tea] What are you talking about? This is the exported quality version, which has less flavour.
The local groceries sell the 'local' version which has much more flavour.
[onyx981] Not sure why this is negged or why this is even considered a deal, unless people have gotten used to bending over for colesworth price hikes on items like these. That or people have an issue with compulsive spending every time they see anything labelled 'sale' even though it's not. Never found a difference in taste unless it's expired.
Heck even my local colesworth caves and sells them at 50c a pack on sale several times or less.
[Skinnerr] As great as these are, they're very unhealthy.
[darxtorm] I don't think people are buying instant ramen for its nutritional strengths
[payton] Massively calorie dense and its mostly carbs, just the product to end world hunger, but not ending world obesity.
[DrMoo] I remember when I was 12 years old in 1996, migos were ~ 15c per packet !!
[Al09] I think coles selling for the same price
[naman8913] https://amzn.asia/d/00CHwfzb same price per pack.
[HmrW] Not bad taste but I still like the spicy one
[McMaferMur] oh no sold out… oh no dinner for next 5 days are ruined
[PissLUR] You can't find satay flavour in Indonesia. It's for export only.
